description: Agent Labor Verification: submit a work-completion or job log with the agreed task list and the labor bill: the task list with its reference and each agreed task with its id, the task and what it covers; the log with its reference, the worker and each entry with the task, its status (complete, partial or not started), the share done, the day the work was completed and a note; the bill with its reference, the billing date, its currency and each billed line with the task, whether it is billed as full or partial completion, the share billed and the amount. The signed report gives the log, the task list and the bill, each task billed as complete against its completion record, each task billed against the share of it the log shows done, each task billed more than once, each completion date against the billing date, and each billed task against the agreed list, and counts them, and names a divergent labor bill: a task billed as complete with no completion record, partial work billed as full, the same task claimed twice, and a completion date after the billing date; then a billed task not on the agreed task list, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No billed lines, no log entries, no status or share beside a billed task, no billing date or completion dates, or no agreed tasks leaves those points unverified. Tasks match by their reference or their words with plurals folded, a reference and a name are one task when both name the same agreed task, and dates compare by the day. This reads work performed against the tasks agreed for it. Verdict labor_completion_divergent, labor_completion_partial, labor_completion_unverified or labor_completion_consistent. POST /api/labor-completion-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.
